questions.text: Can you complete one paid tool call end to end (counted_verify, counted_tagcheck or counted_audit) and receive a Celo settlement hash back? Rate how far you got.
Is the price of every tool stated before any payment is asked for, in the tool description and in the 402 terms?
Do the 402 terms list USA₮ as an accepted asset on eip155:42220, alongside USDC and USD₮?
From the README and /mcp-info alone, could you pay a route with `buy curl` without asking anyone? Rate the completeness of the payment instructions.
Does counted_verify explain WHY a wallet does or does not count (pre-28-Aug history, 60-day lookback, first funder, contract, own wallet), not just a yes/no?
Do the free tools (counted_rules, counted_standing, counted_how_to_pay) answer correctly and quickly? Cite one exact response you saw.
What is the single most confusing or broken thing about this MCP server, with the exact tool name, input and output you observed?
